field.label: Enable Reticulum Bridge
field.help: Enable or disable the rnsd service. When enabled, the daemon bridges the PostInterface backbone to LAN RNS nodes.

field.label: PostInterface Node URL
field.help: Full URL of the Reticulum-PHP exchange endpoint (e.g., https://retichat.com/reticulum). This is the node this bridge polls for packets.

field.label: PostInterface Wake URL (optional)
field.help: Optional wake endpoint URL. If set, the bridge will idle until woken by the remote node.

field.label: Poll Interval (seconds)
field.help: How often to poll the PostInterface node for new packets. Minimum: 2.0 seconds.

field.label: Backbone Bind Address
field.help: IP address for the BackboneInterface TCP listener. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

field.label: Backbone Bind Port
field.help: TCP port for the BackboneInterface listener. Default: 4242.

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Reticulum log verbosity. Higher = more output.

field.label: MTU
field.help: Maximum Transmission Unit for the bridge interface. Default: 500.

field.label: Pathfinder Max Hops
field.help: Maximum hop count for path discovery. Default: 128.

field.label: Enable Transport
field.help: Enable the Reticulum Transport engine (required for path discovery and relaying).
